definitions.short: Aphek (or Aphik), the name of three places in Palestine
definitions.full: H663. Apheq אֲפִיק אֲפֵק ( Judg 1:31 ) proper name, of a location Aphek (perhaps enclosure , or fortress ). **now probable that 1 should include Josh 12:18 ; 1Sam 4:1 ; 29:1 and 2Kin 13:22 : ᵐ5 L; town not near Jezreel, but at north end of philistine plain; compare ᵐ5 L i. with We compare 254 Dr 1Sam 29:11 RS OTJC 2.435 GASm Geogr. 400 f. Buhl Geogr. 212 (and N.) Bu RS 235 f. ; more doubtful are 1Kin 20:26 ; 20:30 ; 2Kin 13:17 (Kit 1Kin 20:26 ); these, with Josh 19:30 ; Judg 1:31 , might denote an Aphek near Jezreel. 1 city near Jezreel (Assyrian Ap‡u , compare Dl Pa 287 ) Josh 12:18 ; 1Sam 29:1 ( אֲפֵ֑קָה , so) 1Kin 20:26 , 30 compare 2Kin 13:7 2 city in tribe of Asher Josh 19:30 ; Judg 1:31 ( אֲפִיק ). 3 city northeast of Beirût, modern Afqa Josh 13:4 אֲפֵ֑קָת see Di. 4 place near Mizpah 1Sam 4:1 (compare 7:12 ).
definitions.rootNote: or אֲפִיק ; from 662 (in the sense of strength); fortress;
